contribute._comment: Expenses shown on /contribute. Recurring rules match Odoo vendor bills by vendor name (regex, needs the private export) or by bill line text (regex, public export); title is an extra condition for vendors that bill other things too; monthlyAmount is the fixed monthly cost shown on the page and wins over the amount read from bills; annualAmount is a yearly bill shown as a twelfth per month (the two taxes: the 2026 bills, the same as settings.taxes.pending); short names the cost in the transfer message, "Contribution <short>" (the fixed costs below are set from the Odoo vendor bills as of September 2026 — update them when a contract changes). Bills matching exclude go nowhere (catering is bought and consumed on the day). vendorLabel names the suppliers on the page when a cost has several; aliases are older slugs that redirect to this one. billed: false marks a cost paid under a contract (the rent): no bill is ever matched to it.

recurring.label: Rent
recurring.title: \brent\b|\bsous.?location\b|\bsub.?rent\b|\bloyer\b
recurring.description: The lease for the space itself: the first floor (235 m²) and the second floor (204 m²), 439 m² of offices in the centre of Brussels. Every other contribution only makes sense because this one is covered.

recurring.label: Furniture rental
recurring.description: Tables, chairs and sofas from Relieve, a Brussels circular-furniture company, and the acoustic phone booth from WeNap: rented rather than bought, so when the space changes, the furniture changes with it.

recurring.label: Internet (Proximus)
recurring.description: Business fibre for the whole building: the coworking, the event rooms, the livestreams.

recurring.label: Electricity (Engie)
recurring.description: Two Engie contracts for the building: lights, heating pumps, the coffee machine, the projectors.

recurring.label: Property tax (regional)
recurring.description: Our share of the building's property tax (précompte immobilier), which the owner pays to the Brussels Region and passes on to us.

recurring.label: Office tax (local)
recurring.description: Our share of the building's office tax (taxe sur les bureaux), which the owner pays to the City of Brussels and passes on to us.

recurring.label: Non-residential surfaces tax (regional)
recurring.description: Our share of the building's regional tax on non-residential surfaces (taxe régionale sur les surfaces non résidentielles), which the owner pays to the Brussels Region and passes on to us.

contributors._comment: Discord usernames never shown as individual contributors on /community: bots and organisation accounts (Open Collective is already listed as a partner; CommonsHub is the hub's own account).

events._comment: Hand-managed events. `featured`: URLs shown as Featured on the homepage whatever their Luma tags. `pinned`: events not (yet) in the Commons Hub Luma calendar, listed until Luma has them or until they are past. Both match an event's URL or its aliases, so an event we host ourselves (src/settings/events/*.json, linked as /events/<slug>) is matched by its Luma URL and never listed twice — those events set `featured` in their own file.
events._recurringComment: What happens every week, shown once as a recurring line on the screens (/events/screen) instead of one card per week. `weekday`: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Events whose name matches `match` (case-insensitive) are these and are not listed again.

door._comment: The #door channel: members post "Open" and the door bot answers; the day page reads it for who is in the space.

shifts._comment: Same slots, cap and wording as the Discord bot's /shifts command (opencollective/token-bot). Sign-ups are NIP-52 RSVPs signed by the member's own key; announced in discord.channels.activities.shifts.
shifts.description: Sign up for a caretaking shift to take care of our common space and help hosting events.
shifts._calendarComment: The shifts calendar the Discord bot's /shifts writes to (opencollective/token-bot data/<guild>/shifts-settings.json). The website writes tablet sign-ups there in the same format, so tokens are claimed the same way. One token per hour on shift.

nostr._comment: Community relays are the record (relay.commonshub.brussels first, relay.commonshub.dev as backup); every event carries i=discord:<guild> and t=app:commonshub.brussels. The site signs with a key derived from AUTH_SECRET (see /api/nostr/identity) and acts as identity provider (kind 31926) for members' browser keys. The Discord bot (opencollective/token-bot, /shifts) is the shift coordinator (kind 31923 occurrences) and attests the keys it derives for Discord members; coordinatorNpub is its key, so RSVPs from both apps point at the same occurrences and both apps trust each other's attestations. Conventions: docs/nostr.md and https://commonshub.dev/docs.
nostr._followsComment: Keys the site follows in its kind 3 contact list. chb trusts annotations from its seeds (the site key among them) and from anyone a seed follows, so following a key makes its annotations count in the published data. The token bot (same key as coordinatorNpub) annotates every token it mints with what it was for; following it puts those reasons on /contribute/screen. Followed since 2026-10-05, on Xavier's go-ahead. The site publishes this list (keeping any other follows already on the relays) once per process, from /api/nostr/identity.
nostr._chbPubkeyComment: chb's decryption-only key for members' emails (lib/partner-email.ts): the dashboard encrypts a verified address to it, chb sets it on the member's Odoo partner. Hex.

paymentGroups.detail: Bridged from Celo (May–June 2024) or swapped from USDC (October 2024); where they first came from is not identified yet

taxes._comment: paymentGroups: transactions that are one thing (a grant paid in tranches), shown on /2023-2024 as one line with their supporting document; txs are transaction ids (every transfer of each counts). vatRegisteredSince: the day we became subject to VAT (KBO/BCE record of 0804.505.132: 'Subject to VAT since May 1, 2024'); no return is due before it, nothing before it carried VAT. Shown on /taxes. Payments are read from the public transactions: a payment belongs to the first rule whose `match` (regex, case-insensitive) finds its description. Amounts paid count positive, refunds negative. `pending` lists the taxes billed to us (the owner's letter of 27 September 2026); payments of the same kind and tax year count against them, and an entry disappears once paid in full. `installments`: the dates by which each equal part is due, for what is past due. `passThrough` is the owner's split of the building's property tax, office tax and non-residential surfaces tax by cadastral income (R.C.) — see the spreadsheet 'Répartition R.C. — Précompte immobilier & Taxe bureaux'. The VAT returns themselves come from chb's latest/vat.json.

rules.match: office space tax|office tax|taxe (sur les )?bureaux|taxe communale

rules.localName: taxe régionale sur les surfaces non résidentielles

fridge._comment: /fridge lists the drinks of the latest delivery from this vendor, read from the public bills (chb). Only crate lines count (a drink comes in a 'Casier de N x size'); deposits and anything else (milk, sugar) are left out. The suggested amount for a drink is what it cost us, rounded up to roundTo, never under minimum; people can always give more.
